name: 执行层-质量问题与跟进明细
description: 质量问题钻取页面，展示质量问题清单、闭环摘要及跟进措施。

components.name: 执行层-质量问题与跟进明细

config.text: 执行层-质量问题与跟进明细

sqlConfig.query: WITH agg AS (SELECT SUM(new_issue_cnt) AS new_issue_cnt, SUM(zero_completed_cnt) AS zero_completed_cnt, SUM(open_issue_cnt) AS open_issue_cnt, SUM(no_zero_plan_cnt) AS no_zero_plan_cnt FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']]) SELECT CASE WHEN new_issue_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(zero_completed_cnt::numeric/new_issue_cnt::numeric*100,2) END AS "归零率", CASE WHEN new_issue_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(open_issue_cnt::numeric/new_issue_cnt::numeric*100,2) END AS "现存率", CASE WHEN new_issue_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((new_issue_cnt-no_zero_plan_cnt)::numeric/new_issue_cnt::numeric*100,2) END AS "计划提交率", ROUND((CASE WHEN new_issue_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE zero_completed_cnt::numeric/new_issue_cnt::numeric*100 END)*0.5 + (CASE WHEN new_issue_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE (new_issue_cnt-no_zero_plan_cnt)::numeric/new_issue_cnt::numeric*100 END)*0.3 + (100 - CASE WHEN new_issue_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE open_issue_cnt::numeric/new_issue_cnt::numeric*100 END)*0.2, 2) AS "质量健康度" FROM agg

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", subsystem AS "分系统", issue_name AS "问题名称", dept AS "责任科室", issue_category AS "问题分类", zero_plan AS "归零计划", status AS "状态", current_progress AS "当前进展", issue_date AS "问题日期", zero_complete_date AS "归零完成日期", pending_days AS "滞留天数" FROM biz_dwd_quality_issue_v2 WHERE issue_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND issue_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%']] ORDER BY pending_days DESC NULLS LAST
